image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a laminated restaurant menu. The menu features colorful illustrations of food dishes (including what appears to be curry, rice, and desserts) alongside text descriptions and prices. The surface is highly reflective due to the lamination, causing significant glare and light distortion across the center. The text appears to be in a non-Latin script (likely Thai or similar Southeast Asian language) mixed with some English or stylized fonts. The layout is dense with images and text blocks.

artifact_observations.location: Throughout the text areas, especially central and right columns
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text characters are malformed and inconsistent. While it mimics the structure of a script (likely Thai), individual characters melt into each other, have incorrect stroke counts, or appear as nonsensical glyphs. This is a classic AI artifact where the model replicates the 'texture' of text without generating valid orthography.

The food items have a 'painted' or overly smooth plastic-like texture that lacks the fine micro-details of real photography. The boundaries between the food and the plate/background are slightly soft and bleeding.

Slight warping in the grid lines of the menu layout. The vertical lines of the text columns do not remain perfectly parallel, suggesting minor geometric instability in the generation of the rigid paper plane.
